cases.name: notebook
cases.json: {"name":"notebook","description":"Manages text notebooks for note-taking and documentation. Supports create, list, read, write (append, replace, or insert), and clear operations. In write mode: newStr alone appends to the end; newStr with oldStr replaces matching text; newStr with insertLine inserts at a position. A write only succeeds on a notebook that already exists: use list to check, or create to start a new one (create replaces any existing content). Notebooks persist within the agent invocation.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["create","list","read","write","clear"],"description":"The operation to perform: `create`, `list`, `read`, `write`, `clear`."},"name":{"description":"Name of the notebook to operate on. Defaults to \"default\".","type":"string"},"newStr":{"description":"Text to append, or the new string for replacement and insertion operations.","type":"string"},"readRange":{"description":"Optional parameter of `read` command. Line range to show [start, end]. Supports negative indices.","type":"array","items":{"type":"number"}},"oldStr":{"description":"String to replace in write mode when doing text replacement.","type":"string"},"insertLine":{"description":"Line number (int) or search text (str) for insertion point in write mode.\nSupports negative indices.","type":["string","number"]}},"required":["mode"],"additionalProperties":false}}
